items.title: A finite type separated scheme covered by two opens with compactifications and dense intersection has a compactification
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)

items.difficulty_reason: For a Noetherian S and a scheme U of finite type and separated over S written as U = U_1 cup U_2 with U_1 and U_2 admitting compactifications over S and U_1 cap U_2 dense in U, the lemma asserts that U itself has a compactification over S (statement lines 9790-9796). The proof chooses compactifications U_i in X_i which are scheme theoretically dense, uses Lemma labelled lemma-compactification-dominates to have proper morphisms psi_i : V_i -> U extending the identifications, and sets Z_i = U  minus U_j (proof lines 9798-9808). It then blows up X_i in a V_i-admissible way so that the closures of Z_{i,i} and Z_{i,j} become disjoint (Lemma labelled lemma-separate-disjoint-locally-closed-by-blowing-up, and the disjointness condition is preserved by further admissible blowups), forms V_{12} = V_1 x_U V_2, and takes X_{12} to be the scheme theoretic image of V_{12} in X_1 x_S X_2, whose projections are proper; a further admissible blowup makes p_1 an isomorphism near the closure of Z_{1,2} by Lemma labelled lemma-blowup-iso-along, from which the emptiness of X_{12} cap (closure Z_{1,2} x_S closure Z_{2,1}) follows (proof lines 9810-9868). This is the point of the construction: it is exactly what allows the glued schemes W_i = U coprod_{U_i} (X_i  minus closure Z_{i,j}) to satisfy the valuative criterion. Separatedness of W_i -> S is checked with Lemma labelled lemma-check-separated by verifying that the immersion U_i -> U x_S (X_i  minus closure Z_{i,j}) is closed, using unique lifting of specializations along the proper psi_i (proof lines 9870-9890), and the extension property of the valuative criterion for the W_i is proved by applying properness of X_i -> S and excluding the bad case via the emptiness above (proof lines 9892-9904). The final diagram of Lemma labelled lemma-find-common-blowups is then filled by lifting along the proper W'_i -> W_i, and Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-refined-valuative-criterion-universally-closed plus finiteness and separatedness of W -> S finish the proof (proof lines 9906-9947). Building the auxiliary X_{12} with its controlled intersection and running the valuative criterion through the glued W_i is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
